growth_reel.caption:
Finding the healthiest instant coffee in India is harder than it looks because of what happens behind closed doors.

When we started out, our biggest battle wasn't marketing or distribution. It was fighting the pressure to cut corners. Early on, a manufacturing partner quietly mixed chicory filler into a production run to save on raw material costs, assuming a young brand wouldn't catch it.

We caught it. And we dumped three lakh rupees of inventory right then and there.

Most consumers don't realize how many brands outsource production completely to third-party factories that treat coffee like an industrial chemical commodity rather than an agricultural craft. If you don't control the extraction, you don't really know what you're drinking.

Transparency is expensive. Compromise is cheap. We chose the hard path.

Have you ever caught a food brand changing their recipe or quality over time? Let's talk about it below.
